name: robots/seohongpark__ocbench
title: OCBench block-cpu-single-task1-v0 (MuJoCo UR5e cube manipulation)
intro: OCBench block-cpu-single-task1-v0 (MuJoCo UR5e cube manipulation), adapted from seohongpark/ocbench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
